newsitem.title: USA: Cabot sees Q1 Dec 31 shr down at $0.32.
newsitem.headline: Cabot sees Q1 Dec 31 shr down at $0.32.

text.p: Cabot Corp said Thursday it expected earnings for the quarter ended December 31 to total $0.32 per fully diluted common share against a consensus estimate $0.35 per share.
The company said it blamed weaker than anticipated conditions in its carbon black operations for its lower estimate.
Although carbon black sales volumes increased from the first quarter of 1996, European and North American volumes fell short of the company's expectations for the quarter, it said.
"(The) Company's carbon black business experienced tighter margins and higher development spending compared with the first quarter of 1996," it said.

Cabot said its tantalum business experienced lower volumes and profits compared with the first quarter of 1996 due to the continued effects of the 1996 slowdown in the U.S. electronics industry and inventory adjustments at the company's customers.
Last year, the company reported a 1995 first-quarter primary share of $1.13.
